Messages.Body:
LSJ made a comment in another post about how if you are Black Hand and
then Clan Impersonate to a Camarilla clan, you are now a Cam Black
Hand.

This got me thinking about the default sect stuff.

There was a ruling that Gangrel are now considered Independent as
default. This came from the canon that Gangrel left the camarilla.

So now Assamites. In canon, they are of all three sects (Cam, Sabbat,
Independent).
In the card game, if you include legacy or blood, there are some
Laibon as well.

So anyway LSJ... simple new minor ruling suggestion:

When becoming an Assamite (clan impersonation), the controller gets to
choose what sect the Assamite becomes.

Thoughts on this? Its a minor change but I'm curious...

Messages.Author: Bram Vink
Messages.Body:


Hmm. My thoughts are the following.

It would be a bad change for the following reasons.
All clans have a default sect. A single, default sect.
For assamites to go against this would create a matter of additional
rules, extra rulebook text, undoubtedly some inclarity as well.

The change would be minor, and add additional rules to an already rule-
heavy game. Since there's no clear reason why this change would fix
something wrong in the game, or add to it's playability/fun, I'd be
against said change.

Change might be good, and beneficial. Change for the sake of
roleplaying, adding rules, I'm pretty sure isn't.

Cheers,

B

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <1174760024.8...@p15g2000hsd.googlegroups.com>, seba

<regie...@gmx.de> writes:
>hi
>
>a question a bit off topic but sitll in line with the default sects
>and changing ones clan. if xavier for example would have a feral
>spirit played on him lose his 2 votes because they are a non-sabbat
>title or are the specials 1 vote, 2 votes etc. not considert "titels"
>as such compaired to say being a prince ???

"X has 2 votes" (or 1 vote, or whatever) is considered a title, just as
much as a Prince is considered a title.

However, it is not tied to any clan or sect. It is only tied to that
vampire being that vampire. If that vampire gains a new title (say,
Baron), they will yield the "X has 2 votes" title.

If Xavier becomes Sabbat, he still has his 2 votes title. If Mata Hari
gets a Writ of Acceptance, she still has her 2 vote title.

--
